narrative: MGX33-2021B-0327 threw a DC ground fault alarm. Isolated the fault down to CB-B04-05 where I found a home run chafed through against the rack upright, the insulation worn right down to the conductor. Repaired the run and resecured it clear of the steel with a proper standoff rather than the tie it had been fixed with. Insulation resistance verified normal on the affected string before restoration. Unit returned to service and the fault has not recurred. The remaining runs in this can are fixed the same way and are worth checking at the next PM.
